context: Late at the izakaya. Two pints in. Daichi is mid-story; Kenji is laughing.
purpose: narrative + banter — long form storytelling between close friends

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: で、その人な、本当に、まったく動かんかってん。
lines.en: So this guy, right — he literally wouldn't budge an inch.
lines.style: Mid-story, beer in hand, two-thirds of the way through. The 「な」 is the pin that holds the listener.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Half-laughing already. Borrows the Kansai for one word.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 本当やって。十分も二十分も、ずっと立ったまま。
lines.en: I'm telling you. Ten, twenty minutes — just standing there.
lines.style: Slaps the table lightly in the voice. The escalation is part of the bit.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: なんで誰も、声かけへんかったん？
lines.en: Why didn't anyone say anything to him?
lines.style: Earnest middle of a story. The straight-man line.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: それやねん。誰も。一人もな。
lines.en: That's the thing. No one. Not a single person.
lines.style: Voice drops half a step for the punchline run-up. Kansai musicality.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: みんな見て見ぬふり、ってこと？
lines.en: Everyone pretending not to see him, you mean?
lines.style: The straight-man does the work. Smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: まさにそれ。日本一の見て見ぬふり大会。
lines.en: Exactly that. Japan's number-one look-the-other-way championship.
lines.style: Full Kansai grin. Big lift on 「日本一」.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Genuine laugh, head back. The kind of laugh that's been waiting since the start of the story.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: で、結局な、おじいちゃんが一人来て、「大丈夫？」って言ったら、その人やっと動いた。
lines.en: And then — finally — one old guy comes up and goes "you okay?" — and only then does the guy move.
lines.style: Coda mode. Slows down deliberately. The old guy is the hero of the story.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Quieter, more thoughtful. The laugh has settled into something gentler.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: やろ。…日本、本当におかしいけど、ええ国やわ。
lines.en: Right? …Japan's really weird, but it's a good place.
lines.style: Honest contradiction. The kind of sentence two pints in. Affectionate.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: うん、わかる。もう一杯いく？
lines.en: Yeah — I get it. One more?
lines.style: Soft closing. Already lifting his empty glass in the voice.
